item.title: Bradford away ticket information
item.description: Tickets for our Sky Bet League One fixture away at Bradford City on Tuesday 17 March will go on sale to season ticket holders with 30 or more loyalty points from 10am on Tuesday 17 February. item.title: Youth preview: Stags U18 v Doncaster U18
item.description: Mansfield Town under-18s are seeking to extend their unbeaten run in the Youth Alliance League North on Saturday, as they take on Doncaster Rovers at RH Academy (10:30am kick-off). The young Stags are without defeat in their last four league matches, having salvaged a late point in a dramatic 3-3 draw with Chesterfield last weekend. item.description: Nigel Clough makes six changes to the side that lost 2-1 to Peterborough in midweek.
